sources.title: CSCEC confirms China Telecom Lingang Information Park Phase 2.1 topping-out
sources.summary: Contractor confirms Phase 2.1 shell is topped out. Includes data center, support machine room and 220kV substation. No operation is stated; exact milestone day is unspecified.
sources.date_semantics: September 14 is current-state confirmation publication date, not the unspecified recent topping-out day.
sources.capture_reuse_note: Exact primary response captured and reviewed in the fifth pass; bytes revalidated and retained here. Current bounded successor search found no newer achieved scoped physical state.
